role: Renders an EntityArrow: the arrow shaft and fletching quads from textures/entity/arrow.png, rotated to the arrow's interpolated yaw/pitch with the post-hit wobble rotation.
scope_reason: Arrows fly in gated recordings (throw-bow-s1), so their pixels are in the compared frames' scope.
notes: lane/entrender: raster_things.c draw_arrow from the frame row's "ents" (EntityRenderProbe): the interpolated yaw and pitch, the arrowShake wobble with the table sin, the two tail quads and the four fins with glNormal3f(0.05625) through GL_RESCALE_NORMAL (a short normal, so arrows light near the ambient 0.4). ent_arrow: three arrows across the view, into a wall and the ground, one burning; 9 views within 7 px (master draws them 2,194 to 2,981 px off).
